facts.summary: Missed primary PVR endpoint at all doses, Phase 3 halted · Phase 2b · AV-101 in pulmonary arterial hypertension · not yet approved

evidence.summary: AV-101 did not meet the primary endpoint of change in pulmonary vascular resistance (PVR) for any of the studied doses
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: the study did not meet its primary endpoint for improvement in PVR compared to placebo for any of the studied doses
evidence.safety: while AV-101 was well tolerated across all dose groups
evidence.program_discontinued: is halting enrollment and shutting down the Phase 3 portion of IMPAHCT as well as the long-term extension study
